root_cause: PR #37914 replaces file(GLOB ...) with an explicit file list in src/plugins/intel_gpu/tests/unit/sources.cmake / CMakeLists.txt, but the new list omits two existing test files (transformations/group_query_attention_decomposition_test.cpp and transformations/remove_fq_before_dw_conv_test.cpp) that were previously picked up automatically by the glob. CMake's _ov_check_all_sources_listed guard (add_target_helpers.cmake:635) detects the mismatch and fails configuration.
reproduction_steps: cmake -S . -B build -DENABLE_TESTS=ON (any config enabling GPU unit tests) on the PR branch cmake/remove-glob-from-gpu-tests; configuration fails with 'exists on disk but is not listed in target sources'.
recommended_actions: Add 'transformations/group_query_attention_decomposition_test.cpp' and 'transformations/remove_fq_before_dw_conv_test.cpp' to the explicit source list in src/plugins/intel_gpu/tests/unit/sources.cmake (or CMakeLists.txt)
Re-run the diff between the old file(GLOB) result and the new explicit list to confirm no other files were dropped
prevention_strategies: When converting a CMake target from file(GLOB ...) to an explicit source list, diff the glob's expanded output against the new list (e.g., via a one-off CMake message() or find command) before submitting, and rely on the existing _ov_check_all_sources_listed CI guard to catch omissions pre-merge rather than in the queue.
historical_context: No prior merge-queue occurrences of this exact signature found in repo memory; first recorded occurrence.
